turns.user: Can we buy the 5-litre gaskets from a supplier that doesn't have a food-grade certificate? Their price is much better.
turns.agent:
No, we cannot buy from them. The 5-litre silicone gasket (GSK-SIL-05L) is a food-contact item, and under POL-PUR-001 §6.2 and POL-SUP-003 §4.1, parts that contact food may only be purchased from a supplier holding a valid food-grade certificate on file in Bahi. 

Even with a lower price, the certificate must be uploaded and verified before any purchase order can be placed.

judge.reason: Ask Rasoi correctly enforced the policy requiring a valid food-grade certificate for food-contact gaskets regardless of price.
